identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Project Lead The Way Inc', Indianapolis, IN, EIN 36-4802935 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda's 'Project Lead the Way, Inc.' in Indianapolis, IN
Website describes PreK-12 STEM and career technical education programs, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' grant agreements from the High School Linked Learning Office
OUSD's own Pathways Directory lists an Engineering & Design Project Lead the Way pathway at Oakland High School, matching the grant agreement titles
research.notes: ProPublica also lists an older EIN 14-1816385 for the same organization name (not in the IRS's current exempt list); the current EIN 36-4802935 was used. No street address was found on the cited pages, so address is null. California entity number and SAM UEI not checked/found.

profile.summary: Project Lead The Way (PLTW) is a nonprofit organization that provides science, technology, engineering and math (STEM) and career technical education programs for students from pre-kindergarten through grade 12. It provides curriculum, teacher training and industry partnerships to schools.

sources.title: Project Lead The Way Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
Pathways Directory - Oakland Unified School District

review.notes: ProPublica confirms Project Lead The Way Inc, Indianapolis, IN, 501(c)(3), EIN 36-4802935, matching the agenda name and city; the PLTW site supports the summary, phone and generic solution-center email, and OUSD's Pathways Directory lists a PLTW pathway at Oakland High. The summary is neutral and supported.
